title: deprecate-legacy-build-scripts-introduce-toolchain-bridge
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: The repo has accumulated several generations of build entrypoints (legacy-make, legacy-scripts/ci.sh, and ad-hoc node wrappers). These lead to brittle local dev bootstraps, duplicated logic across presubmit flows, and divergence between CI and release behavior. This PR introduces a compact 'toolchain-bridge' adapter that provides a single runtime facade to incrementally migrate callers off legacy scripts and standardize tool installation and feature flags. Goals: (1) deprecate legacy top-level scripts with a clear shim/backcompat layer; (2) centralize toolchain boot (node/pnpm/rust/go) into typed.yml manifests consumed by the bridge; (3) make presubmit/lint/test runners consume the bridge so CI and local dev share the same boot semantics; (4) remove duplicated linter and formatter invocations spread across scripts. Migration plan: - Add toolchain-bridge binary (go) that reads manifests/.toolchain/*.yml and exposes a deterministic env + exec behavior. - Replace direct calls to npm/pnpm/setup-toolchain in presubmit runners with bridge invocations. - Add a deprecation shim for legacy scripts that forwards to the bridge but emits a deprecation warning and telemetry event. - Provide a devcontainer quickpath and lightweight dev image to accelerate local onboarding. Checklist: [x] Add bridge binary and manifest loader [x] Replace presubmit entrypoints for lint/test [x] Add deprecation shims at repo root [x] Update CI templates to call bridge [x] Smoke test on linux/mac and ephemeral runners [x] Add migration docs (CONTRIBUTING.md section) Testing: - Ran staged presubmit pipeline on a fork with selective shards (lint, unit tests, python packaging). - Local: devcontainer -> ran build/test/lint with bridge, verified caches and pnpm mirror behavior. - Nightly: scheduled canary run against main for 48h to validate release hooks. Rollout: - This is a non-breaking, backward-compatible rollout. The legacy scripts remain available and now forward to the bridge with warnings for one release cycle. We will remove the shims after two release cycles once telemetry shows <1% usage. Follow-ups (tracked in ENG-1988): - Replace internal release automation hooks to use bridge's atomic artifact stamping. - Add an opt-in dev fastpath (lightweight image) for contributors on macOS. Related: ENG-1930 (ci flakiness reduction), PRs: none yet.
commits: 3 commits: - add toolchain-bridge (go): manifest loader, exec shim, telemetry hook - replace ci/presubmit runners to call bridge where applicable - add repo-root deprecation shims and docs update

release_notes: Introduce toolchain-bridge to standardize tool bootstrap across CI and local dev. Deprecation shims added for legacy scripts; no breaking changes. Contributors may opt-out via TOOLCHAIN_BRIDGE_DISABLE=1 for debugging. Improvements: reduced presubmit variance, consolidated setup logic, smaller devcontainer image for fastpath testing.
